response.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM station_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
  FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average
FROM scored
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
ORDER BY above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted mean across all observatory stations, including stations with zero telescopes; each station is counted once.
